Pictures drawn by mathematics. Spirographs trace the path of a pen on one circle rolling around another, a curve whose whole shape is decided by the ratio of the two radii. Cats on Ladders follows a cat sitting on a sliding ladder, and the curves it traces turn out to be the same rolling-circle curves.
